requirements.general: Entry Level and Requirements INTI Foundation: Pass with GPA of 2.33 in 2 of the following subjects: Biology or Physics / Mathematics or Chemistry STPM / Matriculation / Pre-University: Pass Matriculation / Pre-University / Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan (STPM) or equivalent qualification with minimum GPA 2.33 in 2 of the following subjects: Biology or Physics / Mathematics or Chemistry A-Level: A-Level programme or equivalent qualification with minimum grade D in 2 of the following subjects; Biology or Physics / Mathematics or Chemistry Diploma: Minimum CGPA of 2.75 in related field OR CGPA less than 2.75 in related field and a minimum of 3 years (36 months) working experience in the related field SACE International (formerly known as South Australian Matriculation (SAM)): Pass with minimum ATAR 55-59 including any of the 2 subjects: Biology or Physics / Mathematics or Chemistry NSW HSC (New South Wales Higher School Certificate): Pass with minimum ATAR 55-59 including any of the 2 subjects: Biology or Physics / Mathematics or Chemistry Australian Year 12 : Pass with minimum ATAR 55 - 59 including any of the 2 subjects: Biology or Physics / Mathematics or Chemistry Canadian Pre-U : Pass with aggregate 55 - 59% in any of the 2 subjects: Biology or Physics / Mathematics or Chemistry UEC : Pass with at least 5B including grade B5 in either 2 of these subjects: Biology or Physics / Mathematic or Chemistry. English Language Requirements Local Students: MUET Band 3 or IELTS (5.5) / TOEFL (550) International students: IELTS (5.5) / TOEFL (550) paper-based or equivalent Note: International students are subject to meet entry requirements that reflect similar qualifications and experience as stated above.
